relations.rationale: Practicing openings all week supports Jude being eager to try a new variation, as preparation naturally leads to enthusiasm to apply it.
Practicing openings all week has no bearing on whether Ivo arrived before Jude.
Jude's eagerness to try a new variation doesn't determine how the match will be scored.
Jude's personal eagerness about a chess variation is unrelated to newer members' confusion about the rating system.
Jude's eagerness about a variation has no connection to the arrival order of Ivo and Jude.
That the match uses the standard rating system supports the plausibility that newer members found this system confusing, since it's the same system in question.
The scoring system used for the match has nothing to do with Xavi's height or shelf access.
The scoring system for the match is unrelated to Nell's promise to schedule a follow-up meeting.
Ivo arriving before Jude does not determine whether Tess arrived before Jude, as these are independent arrivals.
The advisor walking in to check attendance is consistent with and supports the claim that he left scoresheets, describing the same visit.
The advisor checking attendance has no connection to Xavi's height helping him reach a shelf.
Leaving scoresheets on a table doesn't imply anything about whether games were finished by session's end.
Xavi being taller than most younger members supports the claim that his height helps him reach a high shelf.
Unfinished games at the session's end is unrelated to Nell's promise to schedule a follow-up meeting before the tournament.
